contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeNewSale(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		if self.CurrentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		if self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then true 
		else self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true 
		endif  
		else false 
		endif 
	postcondition:
		let newSale: Sale in
		newSale.oclIsNew() and
		Sale.allInstances()->includes(newSale) and
		newSale.IsComplete = false and
		newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and
		newSale.BelongedCashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk and
		self.CurrentSale = newSale and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(newSale) and
		result = true
}
